Gulf Paradise Hotel is a Three Star Business Hotel located in Doha’s vibrant retail heartland. Offices of major oil, gas and petrochemicals, government ministries and national corporations are all nearby, making journeys to business meetings short and easy (some are even within walking distance). Located in the heart of the city, Gulf Paradise Hotel is a twenty minute drive from the Hamad International Airport, a short distance from the business centers, hypermarkets, theaters and other public buildings. The Hotel provides comfortable accommodation ideal for both business and leisure trips.
